flora: Moss carpeting large, ancient fallen logs
Moss 'beards' hanging from the lower branches of an Araucaria tree
Liverworts (flat, ribbon-like green plants) growing on wet stones
Small ferns peeking through the moss
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; focus on the 'draping' quality of the vegetation; lush, heavy, and silent atmosphere; emphasizes moisture and age.

visual_logic.composition: A medium-wide shot of a deep forest interior. The focus is a fallen, decaying log completely reclaimed by a thick, lumpy carpet of green moss. In the background, moss hangs in soft drapes from tree limbs, creating a sense of a vertical green world.
visual_logic.ground: Soft and uneven, entirely covered in a mix of mosses and liverworts.
visual_logic.lighting: Deep forest shadows with occasional 'pinpricks' of light filtering through, catching the dew on the mossy surfaces.
